rows.detail: The altar hall and the hall of hellenistic architecture are in the part of the building that reopens first. The house has published a fixed date and is running a public countdown to it.
rows.instead: Das Panorama, the rotunda beside the building, pairs Yadegar Asisi's 360-degree reconstruction of the ancient city with masterpieces of the Antikensammlung. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 14 euro, 7 reduced, free under 18.

rows.want: The Mschatta façade, the Aleppo Room, the Alhambra dome
rows.where: Museum für Islamische Kunst, Pergamonmuseum north wing
rows.detail: The whole collection comes back on the same date, in 25 new rooms across two floors of the north wing. This is the single largest thing that reopens in 2027.
rows.instead: There is no interim display of this collection anywhere in Berlin. The Humboldt Forum's Asian and African galleries are the nearest thing in scale and are open every day except Tuesday.

rows.want: The Ishtar Gate and the Processional Way
rows.detail: This is the fact most trip plans get wrong. The south wing stays shut after the 2027 reopening and the museum expects it back around 2037. From June 2027 the collection shows only a selection of highlights in one hall of the north wing, and the house has not published which objects those are.
rows.instead: Nothing in Berlin replaces it. If ancient monumental architecture is why you are coming, the Neues Museum's Egyptian and prehistory floors are the closest equivalent and they are open now.

rows.detail: Same wing, same second construction phase, same long wait. The market gate of Miletus sits inside it.
rows.instead: The Altes Museum, two minutes away on the Lustgarten, holds the rest of the Antikensammlung and is open Tuesday to Sunday for 14 euro, 7 reduced.

rows.want: Berggruen's Picasso, Klee, Matisse and Giacometti
rows.detail: Four years shut for a full overhaul of the Stueler building, with the collection travelling instead. It was a guest of the Museum of Fine Arts in Houston until September 2026.
rows.instead: The Neue Nationalgalerie at the Kulturforum holds the rest of the classical modern collection and is open, 20 euro for everything or 14 euro for the collection alone.

rows.where: Deutsches Historisches Museum, Zeughaus, Unter den Linden
rows.detail: The museum says plainly that no reliable date can be given yet. Strip-out work runs into mid-2027, and only after that can the builders commit to a schedule. Treat this as gone for the rest of the decade.
rows.instead: The Pei building next door stays open every day from 10 to 18 with changing exhibitions. Single ticket 7 euro, all exhibitions 10 euro, free under 18. It is one of the few central museums that opens on a Monday.
rows.insteadShort: DHM Pei building, 7 euro, open daily

rows.want: A night at the Komische Oper
rows.where: Behrenstraße, a block behind Unter den Linden
rows.detail: The building is being rebuilt and extended. The company itself did not stop, it moved.
rows.instead: The company plays its full season at the Schillertheater, Bismarckstraße 110 in Charlottenburg, seven U-Bahn stops west of Mitte on the U2.
